name: Command Menu
description: ⌘K command palette on cmdk: fuzzy search over labels and keywords, grouped results, shortcuts and hints per item, and a hook that registers ⌘K / Ctrl K for you. Keyboard-complete, light and dark. Part of the Layro System: layro.vercel.app.
author: uvain
oQueDa: Paleta ⌘K com cmdk: busca fuzzy, grupos, atalhos.
ondeVai: Busca global (processo, cliente, CNJ) e ações rápidas.
compat: React 19/Next 16/Tailwind v4: revisar 'use client', trocar framer-motion por motion/react quando aparecer; cores hardcoded → tokens do globals.css.
